title: Direct Knowledge Of Allah 19th Degree 1st Truth Proofs Of The 7 Attributes Especially Life

questions.question: In the passage, what are two main ways Allah’s Essence is made known?
questions.answer: It is made known through revelation and inspiration on one side, and through created works and their effects on the other.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the works connected to Power?
questions.answer: They are presented as skillful products that function like outward expressions pointing to their Maker.

questions.question: What picture is used for the whole universe in relation to Power?
questions.answer: The universe is pictured as a meaningful, embodied book that points to a majestic and powerful Creator.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does Knowledge show through created things?
questions.answer: It shows one holy Divine Essence through creatures that are wise, orderly, balanced, directed, decorated, and distinguished.

questions.question: What features of creation especially point to Knowledge in this passage?
questions.answer: Their wisdom, order, proportion, administration, beauty, and distinct design.

questions.question: Besides its own direct proofs, what other evidences support Life?
questions.answer: The signs of Power, the indications of Knowledge, and the proofs belonging to the other Divine attributes also support it.

questions.question: What role do living beings play in the argument for Life?
questions.answer: They serve as witnesses and mirrors that reflect many signs pointing to the Ever-Living and Self-Subsisting One.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect constant change in the cosmos to Life?
questions.answer: Because ongoing renewal produces fresh forms and displays, showing living activity rather than dead stillness.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying the cosmos becomes a great mirror made of many smaller mirrors?
questions.answer: It means the universe and its countless living things reflect Divine signs in many different ways.

questions.question: Which other attributes are said to reveal the Most Sacred Essence in a similar way?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Will, and Speech.

questions.question: What argument does the passage make from Knowledge, Hearing, Seeing, Will, Power with purpose, and Speech to Life?
questions.answer: It argues that these qualities belong properly to one who is living, so their presence points to Divine Life.

questions.question: Why is Life said to have far more proofs than the cosmos itself?
questions.answer: Because Life is supported not only by living beings but also by the evidences of all the other attributes, multiplying its proofs greatly.

questions.question: What special rank is given to the attribute of Life near the end of the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as the basis and source of the other attributes and as the support of the Greatest Name.

questions.question: Why does the passage end briefly instead of developing the discussion further?
questions.answer: Because it says this truth has already been strongly established elsewhere, so only a small portion is given here.

questions.question: What comparison is made between Speech and Power at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: Both make Allah known, but Speech does so through revelation and inspiration, while Power does so through created works.

questions.question: In what sense are created effects like words?
questions.answer: They express meaning outwardly and point beyond themselves to the One who brought them into being.

questions.question: What does the image of the cosmos as a book suggest about creation?
questions.answer: It suggests that creation is full of meaning, order, and signs that can be read as evidence of its Maker.

questions.question: What conclusion about Allah is drawn from that cosmic “book”?
questions.answer: It points to a glorious Owner of power.

questions.question: How does Knowledge reveal Divine unity according to the passage?
questions.answer: It reveals one sacred Essence through the consistent wisdom and order found in each created thing.

questions.question: Why do administration and adornment matter in the proof from Knowledge?
questions.answer: They show intentional arrangement and precise awareness, not randomness.

questions.question: What is the first claim made about Life in this section?
questions.answer: That it is established by its own signs and also by many other signs coming from the rest of the attributes.

questions.question: How do the signs of Power support the proof of Life?
questions.answer: They show active works that fit a living source rather than an inactive one.

questions.question: How do the signs of Knowledge support the proof of Life?
questions.answer: They show wisdom, balance, and beauty, which indicate living awareness behind creation.

questions.question: Who are the witnesses mentioned in connection with Life?
questions.answer: All living beings are presented as witnesses.

questions.question: What do these living witnesses reflect?
questions.answer: They reflect many evidences of Divine attributes.

questions.question: What effect does Life have on the cosmos according to the passage?
questions.answer: It continually renews the universe and brings out new manifestations and patterns.

questions.question: Why do Hearing and Seeing count as signs of Life in the passage’s reasoning?
questions.answer: Because hearing and seeing are qualities proper to a living being.

questions.question: How does the passage link Speech with both Knowledge and Life?
questions.answer: It says speaking belongs to one who has awareness and is alive.

questions.question: What overall conclusion does the passage build by combining these attributes?
questions.answer: That there is an Ever-Living, enduring Divine Essence known through many interlocking signs.

questions.question: What function does revelation and inspiration serve in this passage?
questions.answer: They are means by which the attribute of Speech makes Allah known.

questions.question: What function do works and effects serve in this passage?
questions.answer: They are means by which the attribute of Power makes Allah known.

questions.question: How is the relationship between sign and meaning presented through the image of “words” in creation?
questions.answer: Created things are treated as meaningful signs that communicate the reality of their Creator.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the created world as a whole?
questions.answer: It teaches that the whole world can be understood as a meaningful display pointing to Allah.

questions.question: Through what qualities in creatures does Knowledge become visible?
questions.answer: Through their wise design, good order, balance, management, beauty, and distinctiveness.

questions.question: Why does the passage stress that creatures are made distinct?
questions.answer: Because individuality within order suggests detailed knowledge, not blind process.

questions.question: What makes the proof for Life stronger than a proof based on one line of evidence alone?
questions.answer: It gathers support from its own signs plus the evidences for all the other attributes.

questions.question: How does the passage use animate beings in a theological argument?
questions.answer: It uses them as living reflections that display signs of Divine attributes.

questions.question: What does the continual transformation of the universe indicate?
questions.answer: It indicates living activity that constantly brings forth new displays.

questions.question: Why is the mirror image important in this passage?
questions.answer: Because it shows that many created things can reflect one Divine reality from many angles.

questions.question: What common feature unites Knowing, Hearing, Seeing, Willing, purposeful Power, and Speaking in the passage’s logic?
questions.answer: Each of them presupposes life.

questions.question: How does the passage move from attributes to the reality of Life?
questions.answer: It reasons that since these attributes are present, and they belong only with life, Divine Life must be real.

questions.question: How does the passage move from Life to the Divine Essence?
questions.answer: It presents Life as a quality that strongly witnesses to the existence and permanence of the One it describes.

questions.question: What does it mean that Life is the “foundation and source” of the attributes?
questions.answer: It means the other attributes are understood as resting upon and flowing from Life.

questions.question: Why does the passage describe the present discussion as only a “drop”?
questions.answer: Because it treats the topic as vast and says only a very small portion is being given here.

questions.question: Which attribute is connected in the passage with revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: Which attribute is connected with crafted works and visible effects?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest a student of creation should do with the cosmos?
questions.answer: Read it as a meaningful sign that teaches about its Creator.

questions.question: What title-like description of Allah is highlighted through the proof from Power?
questions.answer: A glorious possessor of power.

questions.question: What does the proof from Knowledge focus on in individual created things?
questions.answer: Their wisdom, order, balance, regulation, beauty, and distinction.

questions.question: What idea of Divine oneness appears in the discussion of Knowledge?
questions.answer: The harmony and precision in creation point to one sacred source, not many competing ones.

questions.question: What is unusual about the proof for Life compared with the others?
questions.answer: It is supported by its own evidences and also by the evidences of all the other attributes.

questions.question: How are living creatures described in relation to Divine proofs?
questions.answer: They are mirrors and witnesses carrying many signs.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is the cosmos constantly changing?
questions.answer: To display ever-new manifestations and forms.

questions.question: What is the spiritual meaning of the universe becoming a vast mirror?
questions.answer: It becomes a place where Divine qualities are repeatedly reflected and recognized.

questions.question: Which four attributes are grouped together after the discussion of Life?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Will, and Speech.

questions.question: What do those four attributes do, according to the passage?
questions.answer: They also reveal and make known the Most Sacred Essence.

questions.question: Why does the passage say that knowing is a sign of life?
questions.answer: Because knowledge belongs to a living being, not to what is dead.

questions.question: Why is purposive power treated as evidence of life?
questions.answer: Because power directed toward aims belongs to one that is living and aware.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw from all these linked signs?
questions.answer: That Divine Life is real, enduring, and central in understanding the other attributes.

questions.question: How does the ending shape the reader’s expectations?
questions.answer: It signals that this topic is very deep and that what was given here is only a brief sample.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the difference between how Speech and Power disclose Allah?
questions.answer: Speech discloses Him through communicated guidance, while Power discloses Him through the world of created acts.

questions.question: Why are the products of Power compared to outward words?
questions.answer: Because they carry meaning and communicate the reality of the One behind them.

questions.question: If the cosmos is like a book, what does that imply about random chance?
questions.answer: It implies that the cosmos is not random but full of deliberate meaning and arrangement.

questions.question: What kind of Creator is indicated by this meaningful cosmos?
questions.answer: One who is powerful and majestic.

questions.question: Through what characteristics does Knowledge point to Allah?
questions.answer: Through the intelligence, order, measured form, governance, adornment, and individuality seen in creatures.

questions.question: What three broad sources of evidence are brought together in the proof for Life?
questions.answer: Life’s own signs, the signs of Power, and the signs of Knowledge along with the other attributes.

questions.question: What does the passage call the Divine Essence shown by Life?
questions.answer: Ever-living and self-subsisting.

questions.question: Why do animate beings matter so much in this argument?
questions.answer: Because living things display many traces of Divine qualities in a direct and visible way.

questions.question: What does continual cosmic renewal show about the universe’s condition?
questions.answer: It shows the universe is under ongoing living action and is constantly receiving new forms.

questions.question: How does the passage connect multiplicity and unity through the mirror image?
questions.answer: Many separate mirrors reflect one reality, just as many beings reflect one Divine Essence.

questions.question: What logical pattern does the passage use when discussing Hearing, Seeing, Will, and Speech?
questions.answer: It argues from these attributes back to Life, since each requires life.

questions.question: Why does Speech especially support both Life and Knowledge?
questions.answer: Because speaking meaningfully belongs to one who is alive and aware.

questions.question: What is meant by saying Life is the support of the Supreme Name?
questions.answer: Life is presented as a central attribute underlying the full manifestation of Divine names and perfections.

questions.question: Does the passage treat Life as a minor or major attribute? Explain briefly.
questions.answer: Major, because it is presented as foundational and as strongly witnessed by the whole cosmos and the other attributes.

questions.question: Why might the passage be helpful for a believer trying to read creation with faith?
questions.answer: It teaches how to move from the signs in creation to recognition of Allah’s attributes and living reality.

questions.question: What does the passage say Speech does for the human understanding of Allah?
questions.answer: It introduces Allah through forms of Divine communication like revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: What does the passage say Power does for the human understanding of Allah?
questions.answer: It introduces Allah through the visible excellence and effects of created things.

questions.question: How are created things similar to spoken expressions in this passage?
questions.answer: They communicate meaning and testify to the one who produced them.

questions.question: Why is the image of a book suitable for the cosmos in this argument?
questions.answer: Because a book contains arranged meaning, and the cosmos is presented as ordered and intelligible.

questions.question: What signs within each creature are linked to Knowledge?
questions.answer: Wise structure, orderly arrangement, balance, management, adornment, and distinctive identity.

questions.question: What does the phrase “single Most Sacred Essence” emphasize in the discussion of Knowledge?
questions.answer: It emphasizes Divine unity behind the shared order and wisdom of creation.

questions.question: How does the passage strengthen the proof of Life beyond a simple statement?
questions.answer: It layers together many lines of evidence from multiple attributes and from all living beings.

questions.question: What is one reason Life is especially central in the passage?
questions.answer: Because several other attributes are shown to depend on it.

questions.question: In what way do living beings act like mirrors?
questions.answer: They reflect signs of Divine action and qualities.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention fresh manifestations and designs?
questions.answer: To show that the cosmos is dynamically renewed and continuously displaying signs of Divine Life.

questions.question: What broader lesson can be drawn from the universe being a mirror of many mirrors?
questions.answer: That Divine signs are widespread, repeated, and accessible through many created things.

questions.question: How do Seeing and Hearing function in the argument?
questions.answer: They reveal the Divine Essence and at the same time indicate Life.

questions.question: How does Will function in the argument?
questions.answer: It shows purposeful choice, which belongs to a living being.

questions.question: How does purposeful Power function in the argument?
questions.answer: It shows active ability directed toward ends, which also points to life.

questions.question: What final status does the passage assign to Life among the attributes?
questions.answer: It gives Life a grounding role, presenting it as an origin and support for the others.

questions.question: How does the final sentence encourage humility in study?
questions.answer: It reminds the reader that the subject is much larger than this short treatment and that only a small part has been presented.
